notes.title: #TBT to one of our favourite collabs: the Paradox Comic Book! 📖
notes.content:
[h3]It’s been six years since we published the Paradox Comic! 🎊[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33523087/4ee2c505d70d3620d030ccadd8ea65291e3f147a.jpg[/img]
The original Paradox Comic Book by Lau Kwong Shing (@cowcowtony) remains one of our most treasured pieces of Rusty Lake merch in our office. The stunning artwork, blended with Lau’s own interpretation of the lore in Cube Escape: Paradox, expertly brought to life by the incredible team at @zbfghk, still leaves us in awe.

Years before Paradox was released, we discovered Lau’s amazing Rusty Lake fan art through our #FanArtFridays, and we were instantly captivated. His unique style and vision stood out immediately, especially when he pitched the idea of a comic based on Rusty Lake: Roots. We loved the concept, but at the time, we were deep in production for the Cube Escape: Paradox film and game. Instead, we asked if he’d be interested in creating something for the launch of Cube Escape: Paradox, and without hesitation, he jumped right in. The result was a brilliant new layer to the Paradox story, seamlessly woven into the Rusty Lake universe.

We’re still so proud and honoured to have collaborated with Lau early in his career on such an extraordinary project. And now, six years later, we’re thrilled to partner with Lost in Cult to re-launch the [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/rusty-l-para-8lfct]Paradox Comic Book[/url] in a new edition to celebrate the 10th anniversary of Rusty Lake, so even more people can experience this masterpiece.

[url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/rusty-l-para-8lfct][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33523087/614174a6219d3e72bff4647bbd124fe409769576.jpg[/img]
[/url]
Don’t miss out on this beautiful anniversary edition and get yours today!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33523087/0fde4d536e93153a464c15727bcfc02b6c910ee0.png[/img]

Hey everyone! All our premium games, including Cube Escape: Paradox - Chapter 2, are now on sale in the SteamSummerSale for 44% OFF!  And to make the summer sale even better, our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3669/Rusty_Lake_Bundle/]Rusty Lake Bundle[/url] is 52% OFF!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/909150/Cube_Escape_Paradox__Chapter_2/

And with the sale, we bring forth some insights into our plans at Rusty Lake:

Lately, we have been very busy with our first physical escape room: Rusty Lake’s Black Cube Exhibition which went live during TwitchCon Rotterdam. The experience turned out to be a huge success, so we hope to bring it to other future conventions, if possible.  Read more on our [url=https://blog.rustylake.com/our-first-physical-went-live-at-twitchcon/]blog[/url]!

For the past 2 years, we’ve also been working on our first pen & paper, tabletop, escape room: Rusty Lake Untold. We are thrilled to release our first adventure: The Lab for free later this month: on July 24! Make sure to sign up [url=https://www.rustylakeuntold.com/]here[/url] and read how to play.

We are also collaborating with Hiking Mind studio to release their debut title Follow the meaning through our publishing platform: Second Maze. The game is a premium point-and-click adventure with beautiful graphics and playtime of around 1.5 hours. They aim to release in Q3 and we think a lot of people who enjoy Rusty Lake will also enjoy this adventure so make sure to wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720280/Follow_the_meaning/  

Of course, we are also working on new game projects, but unfortunately, we cannot share anything about those plans just yet!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: The Past Within + Rusty Lake Midweek Madness

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/ 

Are you ready to unlock The Past Within? Teaming up with a friend, travel through both past and future to piece together the mysteries surrounding Albert Vanderboom. Communicate what you see around you to help one another solve various puzzles and explore the worlds from different perspectives!

Official teaser trailer:

[previewyoutube=bopzNbExy1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

The Past Within is an upcoming multiplayer point-and-click adventure taking place in the Rusty Lake universe. Next to PC & Mac, the game is also coming to IOS, Android and hopefully console!

notes.title: The Cube Escape Collection is now available! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/cf0f6f168ff467c1a553bc23068435a1e744ffc6.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

We’re very excited to finally release a Collection of the first nine Cube Escape chapters on Steam to survive the end of the Flash Games era:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/

We hope you will be happy to finally have all these games in one place where you can easily revisit the Rusty Lake universe and unlock all the 72 new achievements! There is also a new hint system and our translators did a tremendous job adding translations to all of them.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTKfF1K1MUg

We are celebrating this much-awaited release with a sale, as a small thank you to all of you for the amazing support you’ve shown us over the years. When we released our first Cube Escape game, Seasons, 5 years ago we never dreamed we would attract such an amazing community. To this day we’re still blown away by your continuous support and kind words. Thank you for being such a big part of the Rusty Lake journey!

Good luck finding all the achievements and please stay tuned for future Rusty Lake updates!

notes.content:
Hi guys,

Thanks all for making the release of Paradox such a big success! The movie and game combo was our biggest and most exciting Rusty Lake project so far and we couldn't be happier with all the positive reviews and comments here on Steam. We are very grateful to have such a great community!

notes.title: Cube Escape: Paradox will creep out September 20th
notes.content:
The next Rusty Lake game would be creepy enough without entwining itself with a live-action film, but I’m glad it is. Both Cube Escape: Paradox and Paradox: A Rusty Lake Film will come out on September 20th, telling a criss-crossing story about a detective who gets trapped in a room by an ominous crow. The film and one version of the game will be free, but there’s a paid-for premium version too – though no details yet on how that’ll differ.

The Cube Escape games are point and clickers set in Rusty Lake, a surreal world populated by anthropomorphic horrors. Think Twin Peaks, dialled up to 11.
